verdict.rationale: Transfer lock by default is documented (docs-11, docs-19), and registry lock with custom out-of-band verification is explicitly offered but only for Enterprise customers (docs-12), not standard Registrar users. missing for 10: no evidence of registry-lock availability for non-Enterprise domains, no independent/hands-on confirmation of registry-lock working in practice, and no detail on the registry-lock activation process or SLAs.
